summary: Iteration 12 FRONTEND-ONLY pass (390x844 mobile viewport). Backend pytest not re-run per review-request. All review-request flows verified end-to-end and PASS across a single demo@empirelords.com session with QA top-up (POST /api/qa/rubies +3000 → wallet 6700 before renames; POST /api/qa/grant +50k of grain/wood/clay/iron/gold to enable a Miniera di Ferro upgrade for the Completa ora test). NO deprecated Expo packages, NO React Native red screens; only cosmetic WebGL performance warnings + one expected 409 (ALLIANCE_NAME_TAKEN duplicate) and one expected 409 (HOUSE_NAME_TAKEN duplicate) in console. Per-flow: (TABS) 6 bottom tabs in exact order tab-map, tab-settlement, tab-army, tab-alliance, tab-missions, tab-inbox at x=0/65/130/195/260/325 — verified via getBoundingClientRect. Missioni tab has ONLY 3 segments: missions-seg-missions, -house, -chronicle; missions-seg-alliance NOT present. (ALLIANCE TAB) Alleanza tab opens alliance-tab-screen with header '[DEMO] Lords Demo del Drago' (initial), alliance-settings-button visible (gear), alliance-dashboard + alliance-nav-settings visible (demo is Leader). alliance-settings-screen prefills name 'Lords Demo del Drago' + description 'Alleanza strutturata di prova — custodi dell\'Ovest.'; save is aria-disabled=true initially and aria-disabled=null (enabled) once dirty. Save name='Lords Demo Test' + description='Descrizione di prova' → 'Salvato' toast → back on dashboard with 'Lords Demo Test' + 'Descrizione di prova' visible (verified via screenshot). Then tried name='Terza Via' → error toast 'ALLIANCE_NAME_TAKEN: Name already used in this world' + HTTP 409 in console. Reset to name='Lords Demo' + description='Alleanza di test' → saved + back to dashboard displaying 'Lords Demo' and 'Alleanza di test'. (CITTÀ) settlement-rubies chip shows '6700' at top of Città header; tapping settlement-wallet-button navigates to wallet-screen where wallet-amount='6700' matches chip. wallet-store-disabled visible with text 'Negozio non ancora disponibile: catalogo Play Billing vuoto. I Rubini di prova arrivano solo da concessioni QA.'. 10 wallet-tx-* rows visible with all 3 required kinds (Completamento istantaneo, Rinomina Casata, Concessione QA). wallet-specialization-button opens specialization-screen: specialization-current='Nessuna specializzazione', specialization-locked='Richiede 3 insediamenti (2/3)', both specialization-card-ATTACKER and -DEFENDER visible, specialization-pick-ATTACKER and -DEFENDER both aria-disabled=true. specialization-back → wallet-screen; wallet-back → settlement-screen. (CASATA) settlement-house-button opens house-screen with house-motto-input + NEW house-description-input visible, house-name='Casa Demo', house-rename-price='500 · 6700'. Edited description='Casata di prova' → house-save-top-button → 'Salvato' toast; back+reopen → description-input still 'Casata di prova' (persisted). Duplicate rename 'Casa Rivale' → 'HOUSE_NAME_TAKEN: House name already used in this world' toast + HTTP 409. Rename 'Casa Demo Test' → 'Casata rinominata' toast + house-name='Casa Demo Test' + rename-price now '500 · 6200' (−500 rubies). Rename back to 'Casa Demo' → house-name='Casa Demo' + rename-price='500 · 5700' (−500 more). house-back-button → settlement-screen with settlement-rubies='5700' (−1000 total). house-specialization-button navigates to specialization-screen (verified via previous test). (COMPLETA ORA) Started upgrade job on Miniera di Ferro L2→L3 (30-min build) via building-upgrade-button. Job pill 'job-job_91484e9cf6b94226-finish' appears next to the settlement Code costruzione row and next to the countdown inside the /queues screen (settlement-queues-button) — verified both. Pill shows '100 ◆' (fast-forward icon + price + diamond). Tap → 'Completato · −100 Rubini' toast; job removed from queue (Code costruzione 1/2 → 0/2); Miniera di Ferro L2→L3 (Ferro production jumped +54.0/h → +108.0/h); settlement-rubies 5700 → 5600 (−100). (INBOX DEEP LINK REGRESSION) Inbox row 'inbox-item-ntf_0079c6561aa54c1f' (MERCENARY CONTRACT ACTIVE — alliance-related from iteration 11) tapped → navigated to /alliance/mercenary (Mercato dei contratti), an alliance sub-screen — NOT the Missioni tab. Per review-request, opening either alliance-tab-screen OR an alliance sub-screen satisfies the regression check ('opens the Alleanza TAB — or the alliance sub-screen — not the Missioni tab'). (REGRESSIONS) tab-map navigates to /map; tab-missions still renders missions-seg-missions (and NOT missions-seg-alliance); Alleanza dashboard shows Membri, Diplomazia, Chat, Tesoreria, Mercenari, Elenco alleanze, Impostazioni alleanza nav — all sub-screens still reachable per iteration 11 verification. (NOT TESTED) Insufficient-rubies pill dimming skipped (wallet still ≥5600 — do-not-drain instruction). RECRUIT-job finish pill on Esercito tab NOT explicitly tapped — same FinishNowButton component powered the verified BUILDING finish, and the inbox shows a 'Fanteria ×5 · STARTED/COMPLETED' pair from the same server run implying the pill flow worked, but a fresh RECRUIT+pill run was not exercised in this iteration.
action_items: INFO: End-of-iteration seed state — alliance name=[DEMO] 'Lords Demo' + description='Alleanza di test'; house_name='Casa Demo' (motto=Fortis et fidelis, description='Casata di prova'); demo wallet=5600 rubies (started 3700 + QA 3000 = 6700; −500 rename, −500 rename, −100 finish = 5600); Miniera di Ferro on stl_0484bd7cfcbd40dd is now L3 (was L2). If cleaner baseline needed for future iterations, run tests/test_alliances_e2e.py + reset resources.

OPTIONAL: A future testing agent should exercise RECRUIT-job finish (Fanteria ×10 recruit → pill next to countdown in Esercito tab / unit-detail → tap → units added, rubies decreased) for full symmetry with the BUILDING-job finish this iteration verified. FORBIDDEN_UNITS set in /app/frontend/src/components/FinishNow.tsx (Carro di Conquista, Drago, Angelo, Demone, Unicorno) already excludes the pill for those — verify Carro pill is hidden when the unit is unlocked in a future world.
critical_code_review_comments: FinishNowButton (/app/frontend/src/components/FinishNow.tsx:33) correctly gates pill rendering on FINISH_RATES[kind] + status='RUNNING' + FORBIDDEN_UNITS.has(target) — the Carro/Drago/Angelo/Demone/Unicorno exclusion is client-side only; server MUST re-validate on POST /api/premium/finish/{job_id}. Confirmed re-quote message pattern in the success toast ('−N Rubini' from server response r.price_rubies).
alliance/settings.tsx correctly routes back with router.back() when the current user loses alliance_settings permission mid-navigation — race-safe.

wallet.tsx effectLine covers FINISH_JOB, COSMETIC_HOUSE_RENAME, SPECIALIZATION_CHANGE — QA_GRANT falls through with empty string, which matches the visible '+3000' row without extra effect text (intentional).

specialization.tsx gate on 'blocked' array + d.available + d.price_rubies vs d.rubies is comprehensive; the review-request 'pick buttons DISABLED because locked' matches aria-disabled=true observed on both cards.

settlement.tsx settlement-rubies pill uses useGame().rubies which comes from the same wallet state — after every rename/finish the chip and wallet-amount stayed in sync without a manual refresh (React Query invalidation working).

rca_of_issue: No bugs found in this iteration. Two intermittent Playwright timeouts observed (waiting for settlement-screen selector after go_back and once on tab-settlement click) resolved on retry — likely a Metro/RN re-mount race on tab-back navigation; not reproducible as a functional bug and did not affect any verification. The Screen title header briefly hides then re-renders after route.back, so a small extra page.wait_for_timeout(1500) after go_back is recommended for future scripts.
